opennyai_summary.facts:
In the present case, the samples were drawn on 24.06.2004 by the complainant on inspection of the premises with regard (2 of 3) to 'Pepsi', whereas in the other Varun Beverages Limited vs State Of Rajasthan Through Pp on 17 February, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41840342/
1 complaint, samples had been drawn on 24.06.2004 by the complainant from the premises in question with regard to '7 Up'.
In the case relating to sample of '7 Up', petitioner had sought quashing of the criminal complaint 518/2009 registered under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 by filing S.B. Criminal Misc. Petition No. 2756 of 2014.
Criminal Misc. Petition was allowed on the ground that cognizance of the offence could not be taken after expiry of three years from the date of drawing of the samples.
Samples were drawn in both the complaints on the same day.
